name: SmartFlux EDIS

agents.name: Scout
agents.role: Classifies intent and language; refuses out-of-scope requests; gates operational and financial actions

agents.name: Planner
agents.role: Chooses hypotheses to test, using what H-MEM remembers about the outlet

agents.name: Investigator
agents.role: Runs query templates through Zetaris and the deterministic calculators; never states a number it did not compute

agents.name: Skeptic
agents.role: Re-derives every claim with its own Zetaris queries; can send work back, rule hypotheses out and block the Reporter; rejects double-counted savings
agents.model_lane: deep (Nemotron via Nightshift) for causal judgment

agents.name: Reporter
agents.role: Writes decision cards in English or Malay from approved claims only; numbers are checked against the calculators

sponsor_technology.zetaris: Only live data path: Postgres datasource + Open-Meteo REST table + Unified Semantic Layer (smartflux.energy); apps/backend/src/adapters/zetaris.ts, infra/zetaris/
meterless_engines: H-MEM (apps/backend/src/engines/hmem): baselines, advice, approvals and outcomes across restarts; ledger in logs/hmem-ledger.jsonl
sponsor_technology.meterless_nightshift: Only AI provider: one injected generator, apps/backend/src/adapters/llm.ts
sponsor_technology.nvidia: Nemotron, two pinned lanes through Nightshift; model logged on every LLM-backed event
sponsor_technology.intent_routing: Modelled on Meterless Scout Intent (engine spec unavailable): apps/backend/src/engines/scout

data_sources: synthetic laundromat meter and payment data (data/sample)
